name: Knowtorious
summary: Knowtorious is a live trivia gameshow built for in-person game nights. One screen for the whole room: cast it to a TV, split into teams, and one player hosts while the app runs the clock, the scores and the swings. Five original shows, each a different way to play: Classic (straight trivia on a category board), Heist (steal points from the other team), Vegas (wager everything on one answer), Carnival (forfeits, surprises and swings) and Siege (fight for control of a hex map). Teams pick six categories from a library of 450+ covering film, football, music, history, anime, geography and more, with four one-use lifelines per team. Signed-in players never see a repeated question across devices. Includes a free Daily Footballer puzzle. The first full match is free; later matches use in-game tickets.
